context:
Implement in dependency order:
1) Function signatures: add `duration_seconds: Optional[float] = None` before
   `**kwargs` in `benchbox/core/base_benchmark.py` and wrapper fallback
   implementation in `benchbox/base.py`.
2) Builder wiring: when duration_seconds is provided, call
   `builder.set_total_duration(duration_seconds)` in both code paths.
3) Tests: update and extend unit tests in `tests/unit/core/test_base_benchmark.py`
   and `tests/unit/core/test_runner_lifecycle.py` to verify non-zero duration
   propagation for data-only/minimal cases and no regression for normal runs.
4) Validate with focused tests then `-m fast`.
description:
Data-only benchmark lifecycle paths pass elapsed datagen time as
`duration_seconds`, but that value is not consumed explicitly by the
enhanced result construction flow in both `benchbox/core/base_benchmark.py`
and wrapper fallback paths in `benchbox/base.py`.

As a result, total duration can fall back to query+loading aggregates, which
are zero for data-only runs with no query executions. This produces misleading
run-level duration fields in exported results and blocks reliable metric
expansion work that depends on correct canonical duration semantics.

anti_patterns.dont: convert the canonical duration channel to milliseconds in builder interfaces
anti_patterns.why: BenchmarkResults stores canonical duration in seconds

anti_patterns.dont: repurpose `data_loading_time` to encode total run duration
anti_patterns.why: loading duration and total elapsed duration are semantically distinct
both core and wrapper create_enhanced flows must remain behaviorally consistent

preserves.behavior: Do not remove `**kwargs` from create_enhanced_benchmark_result in either implementation path; existing callers pass platform-specific overrides
ResultBuilder fallback duration behavior (start/end timestamps, then query+loading) remains unchanged when explicit duration is not provided
Standard benchmark result generation for load/power/throughput runs remains backward-compatible
create_minimal_benchmark_result continues returning fully valid BenchmarkResults with existing metadata structure

verifications.description: Base benchmark minimal-result path preserves explicit duration_seconds via targeted regression test
Lifecycle data-only path reports propagated duration via targeted regression test
Core result builder unit tests still pass

work_units.summary: Add explicit duration_seconds kwarg to create_enhanced_benchmark_result in core and wrapper paths without breaking kwargs compatibility
Wire explicit duration_seconds to ResultBuilder via set_total_duration() in both builder-population flows
Add regression tests proving data-only and minimal-result paths preserve non-zero duration_seconds
Run targeted and fast-suite verification; confirm no regressions in standard SQL/DataFrame benchmark flows
